verdict.rationale: Intel says every Core Ultra processor includes CPU, GPU and NPU AI engines. The 285K spec page lists supported AI frameworks (OpenVINO, WindowsML, DirectML, ONNX RT, WebNN). Intel's oneAPI materials also cite oneDNN/PyTorch optimizations for Core Ultra series 2 and VTune profiling for client NPUs, so an official SDK/runtime path exists today. missing for 10: a published NPU TOPS figure with stated precision for the 285K, explicit confirmation that the developer runtimes target this chip's NPU, and independent or hands-on corroboration of NPU developer access.
